children: Stardust Power filed an amendment to increase the maximum Placement Shares available under its at‑the‑market sales agreement by $6,076,872.
Amendment No. 2 increases Placement Shares issuable under the May 8, 2026 B. Riley at‑the‑market agreement by $6,076,872.
Shares will be sold pursuant to the Company’s Form S‑3 registration statement (File No. 333‑294938) declared effective April 16, 2026.
The prospectus supplement framework dated May 8, 2026 (amended Sept 17, 2026) governs the additional issuance.
Legal opinion from Thompson Hine LLP relating to the Placement Shares is filed as Exhibit 5.1 with the 8‑K.
